summary: Frontend-only verification of new Cookie Policy page, updated Privacy Policy links, footer link, and updated cookie consent banner/modal text. All flows tested via Playwright pass with no console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: Code is clean and matches the requested content. RichText helper is reused consistently across CookieConsent, PrivacyPolicy, CookiePolicy - good DRY practice.

Analytics/Performance table row combines two GA cookie names (_ga, _ga_4XF4J9Z8MC) into a single row rather than listing '_ga' alone as literally described in the request text, but this is still 1 row for that category and functionally correct/more complete - not a bug.

No data-testid on individual TOC links or cookie table rows, but existing data-testid coverage (cookie-banner, cookie-modal, cookie-cat-*, cookie-toggle-*, footer-cookie-policy, etc.) was sufficient for reliable automated testing.
test_credentials: Not applicable - no auth involved in this test scope
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified: (1) /cookie-policy route renders correctly - hero 'Cookie Policy', eyebrow 'Legal · Cookies', 'Last updated: July 23, 2026', 7-item sticky TOC all present; (2) cookie table renders exactly 9 rows on desktop as a real <table>, and as 9 stacked cards on mobile (390px viewport) with table hidden; all 9 policy links present and functional; (3) /privacy-policy has 4 inline links to /cookie-policy (one clicked and confirmed navigation works), Square privacy link and Adobe privacy link both present and correct; Fonts section now says 'Our typeface (Europa)...'; (4) Footer utility link order confirmed: COOKIE PREFERENCES · PRIVACY POLICY · COOKIE POLICY · TERMS OF SERVICE · SUPPORT · POWERED BY METHOD - footer-cookie-policy link navigates to /cookie-policy correctly; (5) Cookie consent banner text matches spec exactly with 4 correct inline links (Cookie Policy, Privacy Policy x2, Terms of Service), Decline all/Preferences/Accept all buttons unchanged; (6) Cookie preferences modal intro text matches spec, all 4 category rows (Strictly necessary/Analytics-Performance/Marketing-Advertising/Translation) present with correct updated labels and body text ending in Cookie Policy links, modal footer links both Cookie Policy and Privacy Policy, modal buttons correctly read Reject all/Save preferences/Accept all (confirmed different from banner's 'Decline all' label as intended); (7) toggling analytics on and clicking Save preferences correctly persists {analytics:true,...} to localStorage key xo_consent_v1 and closes modal. No console errors detected on any page. No backend testing was performed per request scope (frontend only).
rca_of_the_issue: N/A - no bugs found in this pass
